description: MiaAI-Lab EXL3 2.9 bpw (codebook mul1, mixed K per tensor, lm_head 6 bits, MTP 4 bits) quantization of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: 39 shards, vision tower and native DSpark draft experts kept in the checkpoint. The n-gram (Engram) tables are not quantized and stay in shards 47 and 48 of the official checkpoint, which this Model lists as a dependency.
